# TS-003: Tailscale Funnel and Serve expose only what is intended

- **Group:** Tailscale
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Funnel publishes a local service to the whole internet through Tailscale's relays, bypassing the host firewall and any tunnel WAF. Serve publishes it to the tailnet. Both are easy to leave behind after a test, and neither shows up in ss or the firewall rules.

## Verify by hand

```sh
tailscale funnel status; tailscale serve status
```

## How to fix it

tailscale funnel reset (and tailscale serve reset) if the exposure is not intended

## What a fix can break

Whatever was reached through the funnel or serve URL stops answering.
